note: Config, not specification. The reasoning lives in the spec on Drive and is never copied here. Every id below must appear in the spec (SPEC-DRIFT). Rules carrying "calibration": true were authored against the written conventions, never against the source, and are expected to need tuning on first run.

rules.statement: No root barrel — root barrels kill tree-shaking and create cycles
No global hooks/ utils/ services/ constants/ directory under src/
Tests are colocated — no __tests__/ directory
*Screen is feature composition and never lives in pages/
*Page is a route wrapper and never lives inside a feature
Fixtures never come from the API client — nothing outside data/ imports mockClient
@/ resolves to src/ — no import ascending three or more levels
No Feature-Sliced Design layout
EventSource is forbidden — a token in a query string is a token in every access log
No axios and no second fetch wrapper — one seam, CasprClient
Every REST call uses config.apiBase, never backendOrigin concatenated with a path
wallet.reserve and wallet.resolveReservation do not exist on the seam — removed, not deprecated
No hardcoded origin or localhost literal in application source
output_ready URLs refuse javascript: and data: schemes
Nothing from the ez-caspr legacy catalog — no /chat-stream?token=, no /wallet/tiers, no Razorpay or PayPal, no browser-side AWS keys
A cast is not a conversion — no res.json() as T on a response body
A fixture is never a prop default — reachable only when a caller asks for it
Empty is empty, unknown is unknown — money never defaults to zero
No collection call relies on the server's default page size of 20
#9c9b98, #8a8a85, #8b8a96 and #e8453c may never be a text fill on a light surface
rules.source: design-guidelines.md §1 Text contrast rule 1 — 'This is lintable'

rules.statement: brand/black #0a0a0a is website chrome only — never app text. App text black is #1a1a17
Opaque accent only — no tint, no pale fill, no rgba or opacity-modified accent as a surface
No hand-typed hex outside the token definition file — colour resolves through a token
Radius is 0 · 2 · 12 · 20 only. Pills and glyphs are fully rounded and out of scope
Every gap and pad is 4 · 8 · 12 · 16 · 20 · 24 · 32 · 48 · 64. Nothing else
Three fonts, no others — Instrument Serif, Inter, DM Mono
Fluid type for display sizes only — UI text stays fixed px so the user's font setting is respected
One structural breakpoint, ~1180. No second viewport breakpoint, no separate tablet layout
Container queries on components, not viewport queries
Flow/grid first — position:absolute only for true overlays
Interactive elements are <button>/<a>, not onClick on a div or span
rules.source: design-guidelines.md §1 (WCAG 2.2 AA is the referenced standard); counted in ENGINEERING-STANDARDS-PROPOSAL.md §4

rules.statement: Focus ring is 1.5px, not 2px — 2px perimeter is AAA (2.4.13); we hold AA
:focus-visible, never bare :focus — a mouse user never sees the ring
Never outline:none without a replacement ring in the same rule
The 2px offset is never collapsed to zero — it is what keeps the ring legal on an accent-filled control
A visually-hidden 'Skip to content' is the first tabbable element
rules.source: focus-keyboard-spec.md §3.6 — 'the file has never had' one

rules.statement: Icon-only controls carry an aria-label
prefers-reduced-motion is mandatory — every motion has a reduced alternative. No exceptions
Duration comes from a token — no raw ms literal in a transition
No box-shadow except the bottom drawer, modal cards and a dragged row
No exclamation points. Ever
Banned vocabulary — platform, leverage, algorithms, workflows, powerful AI, robust, seamless, revolutionary, game-changing, chatbot, web scraping, hallucinate
'Top up' verb, 'top-up' noun. Never mixed, never 'topup'
Data Room · Research Budget · Brief · Study · Intelligence are capitalised proper nouns
Every onboarding footer carries the AI disclosure link
rules.source: ai-disclosure-spec.md §1 — EU AI Act Art. 50(1), in force since 2 Aug 2026

rules.statement: No server secret in the frontend repo — only VITE_*, which are public the moment the app builds
No AWS key, private key, Stripe live key or webhook secret in tracked files
No document files in the repo beyond README.md and README-DEV.md — two live copies of a document is a fork, not a backup
rules.source: CLAUDE.md · CODE ONLY in the local folders

rules.statement: The retired Caspr-Joy/Caspr-app remote appears in no config
eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y installed and enabled
Prettier and .editorconfig present
noUncheckedIndexedAccess is on
File size budget ~300 lines (proposal's own footnote: a proposal, not a citation — recommend a ratchet, not a cliff)
Security headers — CSP with per-request nonce and strict-dynamic, nosniff, HSTS, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
rules.source: ENGINEERING-STANDARDS-PROPOSAL.md §1 — 'We currently ship none of these'

rules.statement: Playwright width matrix covers the load-bearing widths — 1254 (buffers gone), 1180 (structural switch), 560 (centre floor)
axe in CI
CycloneDX SBOM generated at build time
A cast is safe exactly where the type is written in the wire's own casing — a camelCase interface cast from a snake_case body is a defect
Every client method has a mounted route; every route has a caller
Frontend contract types match the backend OpenAPI schema field-for-field, including casing and nullability
Every text colour reaches 4.5:1 against its background
Interactive targets are ≥24×24 (WCAG 2.5.8 AA). Decorative and inline citation dots exempt
Hit targets ≥44px on Compact (design preference, no regulation behind it)
The ring is never clipped by an ancestor overflow:hidden (WCAG 2.4.11)
Focus returns to the trigger when a drawer, dialog or menu closes — the most common keyboard regression
Confirms open focus on the safe control, never the destructive one
Drawer Esc steps down one detent, never straight to dismissed
Pane switcher is manual activation — arrowing must not fire Ask/Versions loads
rail 0 0 64px · pane 0 0 390px · buffer 1 1 0 · centre 0 1 800px min-width 560px. Buffers give way before the centre does
rules.source: design-guidelines.md §10b — the CSS is authoritative over any Figma frame

rules.statement: Bottom nav is persistent and top-most; drawers rise to 788, never 844
Exported PDFs carry XMP: xmp:CreatorTool, dc:creator, dc:date, caspr:aiGenerated, caspr:generatedAt, caspr:analysisType, caspr:depth, caspr:sourceCount
Exported PPTX carries OOXML core properties plus the caspr:* custom part
The mark survives editing and is re-stamped on regeneration
The mark is not conditional on tier — free-trial output carries it identically
Uploaded source documents are never marked — only the deliverable
Initial JS < 200 KB compressed — last measured 206.76 KB
ADRs exist for layout, backend language and auth model. NOTE: an ADR is a document, and CLAUDE.md keeps documents on Drive — where ADRs live is an unresolved conflict, not a check
Conventional Commits
No .env committed in either repo
One index.ts per feature, exporting only the public surface
Pages are route adapters, 5-20 lines
No feature imports from app/shell; no page imports another page
VITE_BACKEND_ORIGIN stays a bare origin - no path segment in the value or its default
Transport refreshes once on 401; a second 401 is a dead session, not a loop
WebSocket close 4401 is not retried; other closes back off, 6 attempts, 15s cap
Red text on light is #be3530 (5.61:1)
The quiet text ramp is three levels: #1a1a17 then #5c5b58 then #75746f. No fourth quiet grey as text
12px is overlay surfaces only - modals, confirmation cards, popovers. Content and layout cards are 2
Controls inside a 12px overlay stay at 2
Instrument Serif is never used for wayfinding or nav
Italic is exclusive to the product voice and a selection echo in a user bubble
Documents have heading structure - h1-h6, not styled spans
rules.source: design-guidelines.md §1 (WCAG 2.2 AA); counted in ENGINEERING-STANDARDS-PROPOSAL.md §4 - 16 headings across 151 files

rules.statement: Keyboard-initiated changes are never animated
Frequent interactions - tag flip, tab switch, scroll - are instant
budget, never plan, in user-facing copy. Must not fire on the plan API field
Exact balances carry two decimals; marketing figures carry none
Sentence case for UI labels and buttons, except proper nouns
Errors carry reason and reassurance. Red text only - no tint fills, no stripes
Depths, file states and wallet terms are never Lingo-aliased. Only Type/Sub-type labels resolve at runtime
Caspr dialogue is engine output - never hardcode it as copy
OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 Level 2 coverage
PCI SAQ A script inventory and tamper detection on payment pages (6.4.3, 11.6.1)
LCP p75 < 2.5s
INP p75 < 200ms
CLS p75 < 0.1
SLSA provenance, Build L2 to L3
Lighthouse CI present and budgeted
Visual regression present
OWASP LLM Top 10 2025 + Agentic 2026 mapping documented
No credential file in any agent-readable tree — including the Drive folder
rules.source: ai-credential-exposure-rules.md R-CTX-1 [P0]; scope extended to Drive by Joy 2026-08-25

rules.statement: Ignore rules carry every required exclusion pattern — depth, not the boundary
No plaintext credential in any agent or MCP configuration
No bidirectional-control or zero-width characters in agent config — the Rules File Backdoor channel
No mixed-script confusable token in agent config — a non-printing filter will never catch these
MCP configuration holds no plaintext long-lived token — OAuth or short-lived credentials at launch
Placeholders use the house pattern CASPR_DUMMY_<KEY|SECRET|TOKEN|PEM|DSN>_<descriptor> — never a realistic-looking fake
No $HOME, parent-directory or Docker-socket mount in an agent or CI runner definition
Secret scanning runs in CI and blocks
No hardcoded credential in source — the fix is to remove the hardcoding, not to note the concern
The agent harness is launched with env -i and an explicit passlist, not from a profile-sourced interactive shell
rules.note: Unverifiable from inside the agent by construction — checking would require printenv, which R-CTX-3 forbids returning to context. Needs external infrastructure review.

rules.statement: Agent credentials are short-lived and task-scoped; a static key needs a documented exception with an expiry date
Only approved providers receive Caspr content
rules.note: Appendix E item 3 records the approved list as not started, but security-posture.md section 2 already names Anthropic, OpenAI and Google with executed DPAs and ZDR, confirmed by Jayant. The two documents need reconciling before this can be checked.

rules.statement: Every secret definition records its tier alongside it
No file whose entire content is a single opaque token — the shape a bare API key takes
rules.source: ai-credential-exposure-rules.md R-CTX-1 [P0], R-CLS-2. Added after CRED-01 missed Ahrefs_Key.txt
